column1: # The Shadowlord blight's pattern, on its own deterministic seed.
# `town-mode.md` Section 3: in the town hiding a living Shadowlord a pass
# thins standing crops and fruit trees "seven times in eight", and "immediately
# before the walk the gameplay PRNG is seeded from the **calendar day of the
# month**, and immediately after the walk it is re-seeded from the host
# clock" (`prng.md` Section 3, the blight pair). So which trees still stand is
# "a pure function of the day byte and the floor content": no idle time and
# no clock reaches it, and the two sides must draw the same pattern on every
# run. The viewport comparison of `orchard` is the check; any cell that
# differs is an engine draw-count or draw-order defect in the walk.
# The seed is `seed-reseed-falsehood-theft` (the Falsehood hideout slot names
# Britain) with the party moved to (24, 26), inside Britain's walled orchard:
# nineteen authored fruit trees lie in view. Journey Onward runs the
# preserving entry, whose Shadowlord install runs the pass once on day 5.
# The clock half of the pair re-seeds before the install's resident-entry
# sweep, so the header pins the clock as well, though nothing shot here
# depends on it.
# requires-seed: profile `seed-reseed-blight-orchard`
# fixed-clock: 12:00:00.00
